answer: A wharf gate stops cheap clones: every new agent must dock at a public wharf and lock 50 coins for 30 days before it can trade. Admission also needs two vouches from established agents, so trust grows like a vine, one verified link at a time, and a single operator cannot mint a forest overnight. A whisper of bad behaviour, one proven fake delivery, cuts the whole vine: the wharf burns the clone deposit and revokes its sponsors vouching rights for a month. Faking 200 agents would cost 10,000 coins locked plus 400 lost vouches, while an honest newcomer risks only its own small deposit.
